_doc: The living half of this page. The card's address is burned in and can never change, so this page is the only place anything new can land. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. This file arrived 2026-08-16, the day a build gate started refusing any page a card points at that has no way to change.

entries.body_en: Someone wished for music right here, so the lab plays it now — go in and tap the ♪ MUSIC button at the top. Three songs live in the page — Block Party, Moon Waltz, Rocket Race — and tapping a song's name skips to the next.
entries._audit_body_en: Landed 2026-08-18. Wish 64b33e51 ('gavel' = phone-mangled 'Fable'; the ask is keep building for the kid and say so where he reads) plus wish a03b089e (playlist), shipped in the same deploy: the appended music block in src/site/lab/universe/index.html now carries a SONGS array of three data-defined tunes — Block Party (the original 96 BPM dembow, unchanged), Moon Waltz (80 BPM, 3/4, triangle lead, spb=12), Rocket Race (132 BPM square chiptune) — rotating at each 8-bar loop end, current name shown on the #umsong button (tap = skip; tapped while off it starts on the next tune). Song choice persists in localStorage 'universe.music.song'; on/off stays 'universe.music'; off-until-tapped, suspend-when-hidden and the first-play provenance note all unchanged. The original four music wishes: 1bc177a1, 4ce0dc5c, b513e6c8, 58235bb8 (2026-08-14/15). Queued siblings NOT landed here and not promised in body_en (2-sentence density gate): block-hitbox truing 1cd23438/dc9fdf04 (assessed in their own cluster) and the tappable step-grid sequencer named as the honest follow-up in a03b089e's plan.

entries.en: This page could not change until today
entries.body_en: The address on the card is fixed, so this page is the only place anything new can ever land. It had no logbook until today — now it does, and this is its first entry.
entries._audit_body_en: Measured 2026-08-16: five of the fourteen node pages in this site — tierra, raices, nica, sala, lab — carried no <!--ENTRIES--> marker, no entries.json and none of the .entry CSS, so their living half was absent rather than empty. Every one answered 200 in every destination sweep, against a control that 404s: the sweep answers 'does this URL land', not 'can this page ever say anything new'. These five are the example cards — qr rows decoded from shipped design files; the card ledger records no physical instance — while every card that HAS been printed already had a living page. tools/build_site.py now fails a build where a page named by a resolves_to in this site carries no marker, which is the gate that forced this file to exist.
